text_es: Create a 'nav' element with a 'ul' inside. The ul should contain three 'li' elements, each with an 'a' link ('Home', 'About', 'Contact'). The nav should have a background of #333333. The li elements should display inline, and the a links should be #FFFFFF, have no underline, and 10px padding.

Create a 'profile-header' div. Inside, include an 'img' (e.g., placeholder.png) with class 'profile-pic' and an 'h1' with text 'John Doe'. The profile-header should be centered with a max-width of 300px. The image should be a circle (border-radius 50%) with a 2px solid #DDDDDD border. The h1 should be #333333 and centered.

Create a 'gallery-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., gallery.jpg) and a 'p' (Image Caption). The gallery-item should have a border of 1px solid #CCCCCC and a padding of 5px. The image should be 100% width of its parent. The caption should be #555555 and font-size 0.9em.

Create a 'div' with class 'form-group'. Inside, a 'label' (Email:) and an 'input' of type text. The label should be #333333. The input should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border, 8px padding, and a border-radius of 4px. On focus, the border should change to #007BFF.

Create a 'blockquote' with a 'p' (This is a profound quote.) and a 'footer' (— Author Name). The blockquote should have a left border of 5px solid #AAAAAA, padding of 15px, and font-style italic. The footer should be #777777 and text-align right.

Create a 'cta-section' div. It contains an 'h2' (Ready to Start?) and a 'button' (Get Started Now!). The cta-section should have a background of #6C757D, padding of 30px, and text-align center. The h2 should be #FFFFFF. The button should have a background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

Create a 'team-member' div. Inside, an 'img' (member.jpg), an 'h3' (Jane Doe), and a 'p' (Role/Title). The team-member should have a background of #FFFFFF, border-radius 10px, box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), and text-align center. The image should be 120px circular. The h3 should be #333333.

Create an 'article-header' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Article Title) and a 'p' (Published on: Jan 1, 2023). The article-header should have a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE and padding-bottom 15px. The h1 should be #333333 and font-size 2.5em. The p should be #777777 and font-size 0.9em.

Create a 'div' with class 'list-item'. Inside, a 'span' (Item Name) and a 'button' (Edit). The list-item should have a border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 10px, and display flex with space-between. The button should have a background #FFC107, text #333333, and no border.

Create a 'div' with id 'cookie-banner'. Inside, a 'p' (We use cookies...) and a 'button' (Accept). The banner should be fixed at the bottom of the viewport, have a background #333333, text color #FFFFFF, padding 15px, and display flex with align-items center. The button should be #28A745.

Design a 'div' with class 'image-container'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., scenic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'overlay' containing a 'p' (Beautiful View). The image-container should be positioned relative. The overlay should be positioned absolute, cover the image entirely, have a semi-transparent black background (rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), and center the text #FFFFFF. Initially, the overlay should be hidden and appear on hover.

Style a 'table' with a 'thead' containing 'th' (Header 1, Header 2) and a 'tbody' containing two 'tr' with 'td' (Data 1, Data 2). The table should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border. The th elements should have a background #F8F8F8 and padding 10px. The td elements should have padding 8px. Alternate rows (tbody tr:nth-child(even)) should have a background #F0F0F0.

Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble incoming'. Inside, a 'p' (Hello there!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #E2E2E2, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 15px 0, max-width 70%, and align to the left. The text color should be #333333.

Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble outgoing'. Inside, a 'p' (I'm good, thanks!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #007BFF, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 0 15px, max-width 70%, and align to the right using margin-left auto. The text color should be #FFFFFF.

Design a 'div' with class 'rating'. It contains five 'span' elements, each with a star character (★). The stars should be gold (#FFC107) for the first three, and grey (#DDDDDD) for the remaining two (representing a 3-star rating).

Create a 'button' with id 'scroll-top'. It contains an arrow icon (▲). The button should be fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport, have a background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, 50px width/height, and a box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2). Initially hidden, appears on scroll.

Create a 'ul' with class 'ingredients'. It contains three 'li' items (1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1/2 tsp salt). Each li should have a bullet point, padding 5px, and a bottom border of 1px dotted #DDDDDD. Text color should be #444444.

Create an 'event-card' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Event Title), a 'p' with class 'date' (Date: Jan 1, 2024), and a 'p' with class 'location' (Location: City Hall). The event-card should have a background of #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 8px. The date should be bold and #007BFF. The location should be #6C757D.

Design a 'div' with class 'scrollable-area'. Inside, a 'p' with 10-15 lines of lorem ipsum text. The scrollable-area should have a fixed height (e.g., 200px), a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and overflow-y: scroll. The text color should be #333333.

Design a contact form fieldset. Use a `fieldset` with id `contact-info`. Inside, there's a `legend` and two `div`s, each containing a `label` and an `input` (one for 'Name', one for 'Email'). The `fieldset` should have a 2px dotted border in #ccc and 20px padding. The `legend` should have a background of #eee, 10px padding, and text color #555. `label`s should be bold and display as block. `input` fields should have a 1px solid border #ddd, 8px padding, and a width of 250px.

Style a single item in a shopping cart. It's a `div` with class `cart-item`. Inside, there's an `img` with class `item-thumbnail`, a `div` with class `item-details` containing an `h4` (item name) and `span` (item price), and a `button` with class `remove-item`. The `cart-item` should have a white background, 15px padding, and a 1px solid bottom border (#eee). `item-thumbnail` should be 60px by 60px, float left, and have 10px right margin. `item-details` should have `h4` as 1em bold, `span` as 0.9em color #888. `remove-item` button should be small, red (#dc3545) with white text, 5px padding.

Present data as key-value pairs. Use a `div` with class `data-list`. Inside, there are several `div`s, each with class `data-row`. Each `data-row` contains a `span` with class `data-key` and a `span` with class `data-value`. The `data-list` should have 1px solid #eee bottom border. Each `data-row` should have 8px vertical padding. `data-key` should be bold, color #555, and occupy 30% width. `data-value` should be color #333 and occupy 70% width. Both spans should display as inline-block.

Design a quantity selector. It's a `div` with class `quantity-selector`. Inside, there are two `button`s (one for '-' and one for '+') and an `input` with type 'number' in between. The `quantity-selector` should display as inline-flex. The `button`s should have a light grey background (#eee), 1px solid border (#ccc), 8px padding, and same width/height (e.g., 30px). The `input` should be text-aligned center, 1px solid border (#ccc), 8px padding, and a fixed width (e.g., 40px), no spin buttons.

Style an item for an avatar group display. It's an `img` with class `avatar-circle`. The `avatar-circle` should be 40px by 40px, have a 50% border-radius, and a 2px solid white border. When stacked, each avatar should overlap the previous one by 10px (using negative margin).

Style a single day cell in a calendar. It's a `div` with class `calendar-day`. It should have a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), 10px padding, and a minimum height (e.g., 80px). The day number (`span` with class `day-number`) should be aligned to the top-right, bold, and 1.1em. On hover, the background should be slightly darker (#f5f5f5).

Style a single item in a user activity feed. It's a `li` with class `activity-item`. Inside, there's an `img` (user avatar), a `span` (username), and a `p` (activity description). The `activity-item` should have 10px vertical padding and a subtle bottom border (#f5f5f5). The avatar should be 30px round with 5px right margin. Username should be bold, description 0.9em and color #666. Use flexbox for layout.

Create a card displaying a single dashboard metric. It's a `div` with class `metric-card`. Inside, there's an `h3` (metric title), a `p` (metric value), and a `span` (metric unit). The `metric-card` should have a white background, 20px padding, a subtle box-shadow, and 5px border-radius. The `metric-title` should be 0.9em, uppercase, color #888. The `metric-value` should be 2.5em, bold, color #333. The `metric-unit` should be 0.8em, color #666.

Style the trigger for a collapsible section. It's a `button` with class `collapse-trigger`. Inside, there's a `span` for the title and an `i` for an arrow icon. The `collapse-trigger` should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), 12px padding, 1px solid border (#eee), full width, text-align left, and a pointer cursor. The title should be bold. The arrow icon should be on the right, rotate 90deg when the section is open (add class `is-open` to the button).

Style a short inline code snippet. It's a `code` element. It should have a very light grey background (#f5f5f5), a dark grey text color (#c7254e), 2px vertical and 4px horizontal padding, and a 3px border-radius. Use a monospace font.

Style a validation error message for a form field. It's a `p` with class `error-message`. It should have red text (#dc3545), 0.85em font size, and 5px top margin. It should appear below the invalid input field.

Create a circular progress ring. It's a `div` with class `progress-ring-container`. Inside, there's a `div` with class `progress-ring-fill` (for the actual progress) and a `span` with class `progress-text` (for percentage). The `progress-ring-container` should be a fixed size circle (e.g., 80px diameter), with a light grey border as the track. The `progress-ring-fill` should be styled using `border` on a half-circle or `conic-gradient` to represent progress. The `progress-text` should be centered within the ring, bold, 1.2em.

Style a completed task list item. It's a `li` with class `task-done`. Inside, there's a `span` with class `task-text` and an `i` for a checkmark icon. The `task-done` should have a light grey background (#f0f0f0), light grey text (#999), and a line-through on the `task-text`. The checkmark icon should be green (#28a745) and positioned to the left of the text.
Create a visual separator for a dropdown menu. It's a `div` with class `dropdown-divider`. It should be a 1px solid light grey line (#eee) with 8px vertical margin.

Create a badge that includes an icon. It's a `span` with class `icon-badge`. Inside, there's an `i` for the icon and a `span` for the text. The `icon-badge` should have a primary blue background (#007bff), white text, 4px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, 12px border-radius, and display as inline-flex with items centered. The icon should have 5px right margin.

Style a thumbnail for a media object (like an article or comment avatar). It's an `img` with class `media-thumb`. It should be 64px by 64px, have a 2px solid light grey border (#eee), and 5px border-radius. It should float left with 15px right margin.

Style a marker for an event on a timeline. It's a `div` with class `timeline-marker`. It should be a small circle (15px diameter), primary blue background (#007bff), 50% border-radius, and positioned absolutely along a vertical line. Add a subtle pulsing animation.

Create a general-purpose card for a user dashboard. It's a `div` with class `dashboard-card`. Inside, there's an `h2` (card title) and a `div` with class `card-content`. The `dashboard-card` should have a white background, 20px padding, 8px border-radius, and a subtle box-shadow. The `card-title` should be 1.2em, bold, color #333, with a 10px bottom margin and a light grey bottom border (#eee).

Design an input field specifically for coupon codes. It's a `div` with class `coupon-input-wrapper`. Inside, there's an `input` with class `coupon-code-input` and a `button` with class `apply-coupon-btn`. The `coupon-input-wrapper` should display as flex. The `coupon-code-input` should have 1px dashed border (#ccc), 10px padding, and take up most width. The `apply-coupon-btn` should be small, green (#28a745) with white text, 10px padding, and 4px border-radius, with no border.
Style a user's short biography text. It's a `p` with class `user-bio`. It should have a font size of 0.9em, line-height of 1.6, and text color #444. Limit to 3 lines with ellipsis if it overflows.

An anchor `a.nav-item` inside a `nav.main-nav`. The nav items are inline-block with 15px horizontal padding and 10px vertical padding. Text is #333, no underline, sans-serif. On hover, background is #f0f0f0. The nav has a 1px solid #eee bottom border.

A div `div.image-container` containing an `img.main-image` and a `div.caption-overlay`. The container is `position: relative`. The image is 100% width. The overlay is at the bottom, 0 bottom, 0 left/right, 30px height, #000 with 0.7 opacity, white text, centered, 10px padding.

A `span.notification-badge` with text inside. It has #ff4d4f background, white text, 8px horizontal padding, 4px vertical padding, 10px border-radius. Font size 0.8em, bold. Display inline-block, 5px left margin.

A `li.bullet-item` within a `ul.custom-list`. The list has `list-style-type: none`. Each `li` should have a custom circular bullet (e.g., `content: '•'`) that is #007bff color, 1em, and 10px left margin for the text.
A `tr.data-row` within a `table`. The table has borders. On hover, the `tr` has a #e6f7ff background color. The text color within the row remains #333. Cells have 8px padding.
A `div.section-divider` with a `span.divider-text`. The div has a 1px solid #ddd top and bottom border. The text is #999, 0.9em, background #fff, padded horizontally, centered over the line.

Create a page with a main heading `h1.page-title` and a subheading `p.page-subtitle`. The main title should be #333 and 2.5em, centered. The subtitle should be #666 and 1.2em, also centered, with 10px top margin.

Design a `div.cta-section` containing a `h2.cta-heading` and a `button.cta-button`. The section should have #e9f7ef background, 20px padding, and 10px border-radius. Heading #28a745, 1.8em, centered. Button #28a745 background, white text, 12px padding, 8px border-radius, no border.

Design a `li.feature-item` inside a `ul.feature-list`. Each item should have an `i.feature-icon` (e.g., Font Awesome) and `span.feature-text`. Icon #007bff, 1.2em. Text #333, 1em. Add 5px bottom margin to each item.

Style `button.group-button` elements inside a `div.button-group`. Each button should have #eee background, #333 text, 8px padding, 1px solid #ccc border. Remove border-radius on left/right edges for middle buttons. First button has left radius, last has right.

Design a `div.testimonial-card` with a `p.testimonial-text` and `span.testimonial-author`. The card should have #f9f9f9 background, 20px padding, 1px solid #eee border, 10px border-radius. Text #444, italic. Author #777, 0.9em, text-align right, 10px top margin.

Design a `div.gallery-item` containing `img.thumb-img`. Item should be 120px x 120px, `overflow: hidden`, 1px solid #ddd border. Image `object-fit: cover`. On hover, scale image to 1.1 and add a #007bff 2px solid border to the item (transition 0.3s).

Create a `div` with class `.card-top-border`. It should have a white background, 20px padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd) on all sides except the top, which should be 3px solid blue (#007bff). Contains a `p` (card-text) with #444 color.
Style an `input` with type 'number' and class `.quantity-input`. It should be 40px wide, centered text, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), and 5px border-radius. Font size 1em.
Style a `span` with class `.article-date`. It should have a small font size (0.85em), light grey color (#777), and be italic. Add a bottom margin of 5px.
Style a `label` with class `.form-label`. It should be bold, 0.9em font size, and have a dark grey color (#333). Add a bottom margin of 5px to it.
Style a `tr` with class `.data-row`. It should have a default white background. On hover, the background should change to a very light blue (#f5faff). Contains `td` elements.

Style an `input` with class `.search-input`. It should have 10px padding, 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), and 5px border-radius. Include a `span` (search-icon) element next to it, styled with a grey color (#888) and a suitable icon (e.g. '🔍'). The icon should be visually integrated on the left side of the input field.

Style a `span` with class `.feature-icon`. It should be 24px by 24px, circular, with a light blue background (#e0f2f7) and a dark blue icon (e.g. '⭐' with color #00bcd4) centered within it. Add a right margin of 10px.

Style a `span` with class `.rating-star`. It should display a yellow star '⭐' with a font size of 1.2em. Active stars (`.filled`) should be yellow, inactive ones (`.empty`) should be light grey (#ccc).

Create a `div` with class `.user-status`. It contains a `span` (status-dot) (10px by 10px, green background for online, red for offline, circular), and an adjacent `span` (status-text) with dark grey text (#333) and 0.9em font. Align them horizontally with 5px spacing.

Design an interactive grid item (.grid-item) with a light gray background (#f8f8f8), a subtle border (1px solid #eee), 10px padding, and a hover effect that slightly changes the background color (#f0f0f0).

Create a `div` with class `card-container` containing a `h3` with class `card-title` and a `p` with class `card-content`. The container should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), a 1px solid light grey border (#ddd), 15px padding, and a max-width of 300px. The title should be dark grey (#333), 1.2em font-size. The content should be slightly lighter grey (#666), 0.9em font-size.

Create a `div` with class `feature-box`. Inside, there's a `h4` with class `feature-title` and a `p` with class `feature-description`. The box should have a white background, 15px padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), and a subtle box-shadow. The title should be a medium grey (#444), 1.1em font-size. The description should be a lighter grey (#777).

Design a `span` with class `notification-bubble`. It should be 20px by 20px, have a red background (#dc3545), white text, a border-radius of 50%, display as `inline-block`, and be centered vertically and horizontally within its own space.
Design a `hr` with class `section-divider`. It should have a 1px solid very light grey border (#eee), 20px vertical margin, and no default browser styling.

Style an `li` with class `key-feature`. It contains a `span` with class `feature-name` and a `span` with class `feature-value`. The list item should have 6px vertical padding. The name should be bold, dark grey (#333), and have 10px right margin. The value should be light grey (#666).

Design a `div` with class `warning-alert`. It contains an `i` with class `alert-icon` and a `p` with class `alert-message`. The box should have a light yellow background (#fff3cd), a 1px solid orange border (#ffc107), 15px padding, and orange text (#856404). The icon should have 10px right margin.

Style an `input` with type 'text' and class `search-input`. It should have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#ccc), a border-radius of 4px, and a placeholder text color of light grey (#999).

Create a `div` with class `comparison-item`. It contains a `h4` with class `item-name` and a `ul` with class `item-features`. The item should have a white background, 20px padding, a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), and a slight box-shadow. The name should be dark blue (#007bff). Features should be a simple list with grey text (#555).

Create a `button` with class `icon-button`. It contains an `i` with class `btn-icon`. The button should be 30px by 30px, display `inline-flex`, be centered, have a light grey background (#eee), dark grey text (#555), a border-radius of 4px, and no border. On hover, the background should darken slightly (#ddd).

Style an `a` tag with class `dropdown-option`. It should have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, dark grey text (#333), no underline, and display as block. On hover, the background should be light blue (#e0f7fa).

Create a group of three buttons. Each button should have a light gray background (#eee), 5px padding, a 1px solid border (#ccc), and a 3px border-radius. On hover, the background should turn dark gray (#ddd) and the text color black. The buttons should be displayed inline. Use classes: .button-group, .action-button.

Create a button for a 'danger' action (e.g., delete). It should have a red background (#dc3545), white text, 12px padding, and 5px border-radius. On hover, the background should darken (#c82333) and the text color remain white. Use classes: .danger-button.

` element. Style it with `color: #6c757d;`, `font-size: 0.9em;`, `font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;` and `line-height: 1.4;`.
An `<input type="text" class="rounded-input">` element. Style it with `padding: 10px;`, `border: 1px solid #ccc;`, `border-radius: 20px;`, `font-size: 1em;` and `width: 200px;`.

A `<span class="dot">` element. Style it with `display: inline-block;`, `width: 8px;`, `height: 8px;`, `border-radius: 50%;`, `background-color: #28a745;` and `margin-right: 5px;`.
